note: Compiled from BADAN_MASTER_BLUEPRINT.md by scripts/mine-blueprint workflow. Source of truth for the app registry. (§22/23/55 Insight generation) v0.2.0 (EPIC-29) adds the nine journal_correlation_* templates: the three finding outcomes (higher / lower / no clear association), the three suppression messages (total shortfall, too few WITH days, too few WITHOUT days), the context-status disclosure, the power-mode numbers line, and the LOCKED association-not-cause footer that CorrelationEngine appends to every rendered card. Note what is deliberately shipped as a template rather than an empty state: 'no clear association' is a first-class outcome, and suppression below the minimum-n gates has authored, bilingual copy that names the shortfall instead of showing a hedged number. The pre-existing correlation_association template belongs to the metric-vs-metric Correlation Lab (rho-based) and is a different feature — the journal engine does not use it.

templates.conditionEn: Latest value sits inside the personal baseline band (|z| < 1) against the default context baseline.
templates.textEn: Your {metric} is {value} today, right in your usual range (around {baseline}).
templates.textAr: قيمة {metric} لديك اليوم هي {value}، ضمن نطاقك المعتاد (حوالي {baseline}).

templates.conditionEn: Value below the personal baseline band (z <= -1) for a recovery-signal metric such as HRV.
templates.textEn: Your {metric} is reading {value}, a little below your usual {baseline} so far this week.
templates.textAr: قيمة {metric} لديك هي {value}، أقل قليلاً من معتادك {baseline} حتى الآن هذا الأسبوع.

templates.conditionEn: Value above the personal baseline band (z >= +1), single-day, not yet a persisted composite.
templates.textEn: Your {metric} is {value}, slightly above your typical {baseline}. This can show up after a busier or warmer day.
templates.textAr: معدل {metric} لديك هو {value}، أعلى قليلاً من معتادك {baseline}. قد يظهر ذلك بعد يوم أكثر انشغالاً أو دفئاً.

templates.conditionEn: Composite deviation: three or more vitals outside their bands in the same direction, persisted for {value} consecutive days.
templates.textEn: A few of your vitals, {metric} among them, have sat a little outside their usual bands together over the last {value} days.
templates.textAr: عدد من مؤشراتك الحيوية، ومنها {metric}، بقيت خارج نطاقاتها المعتادة معاً خلال آخر {value} أيام.

templates.conditionEn: Rolling delta over the window is a meaningful favorable change (|delta| >= 0.8 x pooled MAD, direction good).
templates.textEn: Your {metric} has been moving in a good direction lately, {value} now versus your recent baseline of {baseline}.
templates.textAr: يتحسّن {metric} لديك مؤخراً، إذ بلغ {value} الآن مقارنةً بخط أساسك الأخير البالغ {baseline}.

templates.conditionEn: Sleep-bank-type metric declined meaningfully versus the prior window and now sits below the personal baseline band.
templates.textEn: Your {metric} has slipped to {value} this week, a bit under your usual {baseline}. A few earlier nights could help it settle back.
templates.textAr: انخفض {metric} لديك إلى {value} هذا الأسبوع، أقل قليلاً من معتادك {baseline}. قد تساعده بعض الليالي المبكرة على العودة إلى وضعه الطبيعي.

templates.conditionEn: Baseline is still provisional (coverage below the registry minimum); calibration-honesty template with allow_provisional.
templates.textEn: We're still learning your typical {metric}. So far it's around {baseline}, and a few more days of data will make this steadier.
templates.textAr: ما زلنا نتعرّف على مستواك المعتاد من {metric}. حتى الآن يقارب {baseline}، وبضعة أيام إضافية من البيانات ستجعله أكثر ثباتاً.

templates.conditionEn: Window coverage is below 60%, so a trend cannot be computed and must render as insufficient data.
templates.textEn: There isn't enough {metric} data in this window to show a reliable trend yet. Keep logging and it will fill in.
templates.textAr: لا توجد بيانات كافية عن {metric} في هذه الفترة لعرض اتجاه موثوق بعد. واصل التسجيل وسيكتمل تدريجياً.

templates.conditionEn: Active status is Sick; value is compared to the status-specific (sick) baseline, and performance-critique phrasing is suppressed (Karim safeguard).
templates.textEn: While you're marked as feeling under the weather, your {metric} of {value} is in line with your typical rest-day range ({baseline}).
templates.textAr: بينما سجّلت أنك تشعر بالتوعّك، جاء {metric} لديك عند {value} متوافقاً مع نطاقك المعتاد في أيام الراحة ({baseline}).

templates.conditionEn: Cycle-phase-conditioned baseline (evaluated on-device only); value is typical for the current phase band.
templates.textEn: For this phase of your cycle, a {metric} of {value} is typical for you (your phase baseline is about {baseline}).
templates.textAr: في هذه المرحلة من دورتك، يُعدّ {metric} البالغ {value} أمراً معتاداً بالنسبة لك (خط أساس هذه المرحلة يقارب {baseline}).

templates.conditionEn: Correlation Lab result passing all gates (n >= 20, FDR-corrected); |rho| in a defined strength band. Uses {metric2} for the paired metric and {strength} for the mandated strength word.
templates.textEn: In your data so far, {metric} and {metric2} tend to move together, a {strength} association. This is a pattern in your numbers, not a cause.
templates.textAr: في بياناتك حتى الآن، يميل {metric} و{metric2} إلى التغيّر معاً، وهو ارتباط {strength}. هذا نمط في أرقامك وليس سبباً.

templates.conditionEn: Metric has returned inside the personal baseline band after at least one prior day outside it.
templates.textEn: Your {metric} is back within your usual range today at {value} (baseline {baseline}) after a couple of days outside it.
templates.textAr: عاد {metric} لديك إلى نطاقك المعتاد اليوم عند {value} (خط الأساس {baseline}) بعد يومين خارجه.

templates.conditionEn: Metric has stayed within its target band for {value} consecutive days (streak_ge predicate); positive, non-moralizing reinforcement.
templates.textEn: That's {value} nights in a row your {metric} has landed in a healthy range for you (around {baseline}). Nice consistency.
templates.textAr: هذه {value} ليالٍ متتالية يبقى فيها {metric} لديك ضمن نطاق جيد بالنسبة لك (حوالي {baseline}). استمرارية رائعة.

templates.conditionEn: LOCKED FOOTER. Appended by CorrelationEngine to EVERY rendered journal-correlation card — the positive, the negative and the null alike — in both languages. It is not selected by a condition and it is not optional: a finding card without this line is the failure mode EPIC-29 exists to prevent, and CorrelationEngineTests / CorrelationEngineGoldenTest assert its presence on every rendered outcome. Changing this wording is a copy-review change (plan §11 'stats-copy review'), not an edit.
templates.textEn: This is an association in your own logged data, not a cause.
templates.textAr: هذا ارتباط في بياناتك المسجّلة، وليس سببًا.

templates.conditionEn: Journal correlation passing both minimum-n gates (>= minObservedDays paired days AND >= minDaysPerArm in each arm) whose bootstrap CI lies entirely above zero: next-day scores ran higher after the behaviour. {nPhrase}/{nWithPhrase}/{nWithout} are the day counts, {behavior} the dictionary label, {score} the metric name. {nPhrase} and {nWithPhrase} (not bare {n}/{nWith}) are pre-agreed count-noun phrases: nWith can land in the 3-10 Arabic plural bracket as often as the 11+ bracket, and while nObserved cannot today (minObservedDays is 14), the template does not hardcode a noun form that depends on that constant never dropping — see CorrelationDayCount's doc comment.
templates.textEn: Across {nPhrase} you logged, your next-day {score} tended to be higher after {behavior} ({nWithPhrase} with, {nWithout} without).
templates.textAr: خلال {nPhrase} سجّلتها، مال {score} في اليوم التالي إلى الارتفاع بعد {behavior} ({nWithPhrase} مع و{nWithout} بدون).

templates.conditionEn: Same gates as journal_correlation_higher, bootstrap CI lying entirely below zero: next-day scores ran lower after the behaviour. Phrased as a direction in the user's own numbers, never as a warning and never as advice to stop. {nPhrase}/{nWithPhrase} carry pre-agreed Arabic count-noun form — see journal_correlation_higher's note.
templates.textEn: Across {nPhrase} you logged, your next-day {score} tended to be lower after {behavior} ({nWithPhrase} with, {nWithout} without).
templates.textAr: خلال {nPhrase} سجّلتها، مال {score} في اليوم التالي إلى الانخفاض بعد {behavior} ({nWithPhrase} مع و{nWithout} بدون).

templates.conditionEn: Both gates passed and the bootstrap CI spans zero. A FIRST-CLASS SHIPPED OUTCOME, not an empty state: the comparison was made, it had enough days behind it, and it found nothing clear. A correlation feature that only ever renders hits is a slot machine, so this template is authored to the same standard as the two above and is asserted by the null-case golden. {nPhrase}/{nWithPhrase} carry pre-agreed Arabic count-noun form — see journal_correlation_higher's note.
templates.textEn: Across {nPhrase} you logged, your next-day {score} looked about the same with and without {behavior} ({nWithPhrase} with, {nWithout} without). No clear association so far.
templates.textAr: خلال {nPhrase} سجّلتها، بدا {score} في اليوم التالي متقاربًا مع {behavior} وبدونه ({nWithPhrase} مع و{nWithout} بدون). لا يوجد ارتباط واضح حتى الآن.

templates.conditionEn: SUPPRESSED — fewer than minObservedDays paired days. No finding is computed, stored or shown; this is the 'not yet' row that names the shortfall ({days} more logged days) instead of showing a number with a warning on it. Small-n suppression is a hard invariant, so this template must never be reworded into a hedged finding. {days} arrives pre-formatted by CorrelationDayCount (1 singular / 2 dual / 3-10 plural / 11+ indeclinable, matching StressTrendCard.dayCount / CalibrationCount.dayPhrase / HomeArabicCount.phrase) — it already carries 'more day(s)'/'يومًا إضافيًا' or its correctly-declined equivalent, so no noun or adjective may be hardcoded around it in this template.
templates.textEn: There aren't enough logged days yet to compare your {score} with and without {behavior}. About {days} of journaling would let this be looked at.
templates.textAr: لا توجد أيام مسجّلة كافية بعد لمقارنة {score} لديك مع {behavior} وبدونه. نحو {days} من التسجيل يتيح النظر في ذلك.

templates.conditionEn: SUPPRESSED — enough days overall, but fewer than minDaysPerArm days WITH the behaviour. Named separately from journal_correlation_needs_days because the shortfall is different and so is what would resolve it; a single generic message would tell the user to keep journaling when what is missing is days the behaviour actually happened. {days} is pre-formatted by CorrelationDayCount — see journal_correlation_needs_days's note; no noun/adjective may be hardcoded around it here either.
templates.textEn: You've logged plenty of days, but only {nWith} of them included {behavior}. About {days} would let your {score} be compared.
templates.textAr: سجّلت أيامًا كثيرة، لكن {nWith} منها فقط تضمّنت {behavior}. نحو {days} يتيح مقارنة {score} لديك.

templates.conditionEn: SUPPRESSED — enough days overall, but fewer than minDaysPerArm days WITHOUT the behaviour. A comparison needs both arms; a near-daily habit has almost no 'without' days, and saying so plainly is more honest than a finding built on two of them. {days} is pre-formatted by CorrelationDayCount — see journal_correlation_needs_days's note; no noun/adjective may be hardcoded around it here either.
templates.textEn: Almost every day you logged included {behavior}, so there's little to compare it against yet — about {days} would let your {score} be compared.
templates.textAr: معظم الأيام التي سجّلتها تضمّنت {behavior}، لذا لا يوجد ما يكفي للمقارنة بعد — نحو {days} يتيح مقارنة {score} لديك.

templates.conditionEn: Appended to a finding whose window overlaps a declared ContextStatus (travel/illness/fasting/altitude/injury). The days are COUNTED and disclosed, never dropped or adjusted — the confidence is capped by ContextAnnotator instead. Says what was done, so the reader can weigh it.
templates.textEn: {days} of these days fell inside a period you marked as unusual, so this is shown with lower confidence. Those days are still counted exactly as you logged them.
templates.textAr: {days} من هذه الأيام وقعت ضمن فترة وصفتها بأنها غير معتادة، لذلك يُعرض هذا بثقة أقل. وما زالت تلك الأيام محسوبة تمامًا كما سجّلتها.

templates.conditionEn: POWER MODE line for a journal correlation. Renders the same numbers the casual sentence is built from — one computation, two altitudes (D-5), never a second code path. Effect size is Cliff's delta; the interval is a percentile bootstrap over {iterations} resamples with a fixed published seed, so the same data always yields the same interval.
templates.textEn: n = {n} ({nWith} with / {nWithout} without) · Cliff's delta {delta} · 95% CI [{ciLow}, {ciHigh}] · bootstrap {iterations} resamples · confidence {confidence}
templates.textAr: العدد = {n} ({nWith} مع / {nWithout} بدون) · دلتا كليف {delta} · فاصل ثقة ٩٥٪ [{ciLow}, {ciHigh}] · بوتستراب {iterations} إعادة اعتيان · الثقة {confidence}

wellnessRules: Avoid diagnosis frames ('you may have', 'signs of', named conditions, 'normal/abnormal'). Prefer neutral self-referenced observation: 'your {metric} is reading below your usual range'.
Avoid treatment or dosing directives ('increase your dose', 'take X', 'you should medicate'). Prefer optional lifestyle nudges framed as a free choice: 'an earlier night could help'.
Avoid fear or alarm words (dangerous, alarming, at risk, worrying, critical, abnormal, scary). Prefer calm, measured wording: 'a little outside your usual band'.
Avoid moral judgment (you failed, bad day, lazy, cheat day, guilty). Prefer non-judgmental framing that praises consistency, not virtue.
Avoid causal claims (causes, caused by, because of your, proves, leads to). Prefer association language: 'tends to follow', 'often associated with', 'in your data'.
Scale confidence to data quality: when a baseline is provisional or coverage is low, always include a hedge ('may', 'tends to', 'so far', 'in your data').
Be status-aware: when Sick or Injured is active, suppress performance-critique phrasing and compare vitals to the status-specific baseline, never the default one.

Reserve any mention of a professional for the single reviewed persistence template ('worth discussing with a professional if it persists'); never volunteer clinical referral elsewhere, and keep the Arabic authored and equally guardrail-safe (no diagnosis, fear, or causal terms), not machine-translated.
